stories.title: Sources: Probe into Clips, Kawhi could go into '27
stories.summary: The NBA investigation into whether the Clippers circumvented the salary cap to pay Kawhi Leonard could drag into 2027 if the parties don't agree on the findings or any proposed settlement that involves punishing the team, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Allen backs Bills' panned new unis: 'Stop hating'
stories.summary: Josh Allen defended the Bills' widely panned alternate uniforms, saying the franchise has to "move forward and do something new."

stories.title: Storm apologize after Cunningham fans confronted
stories.summary: The Storm apologized Wednesday for an exchange that took place between one of their co-owners and two fans who thanked Sophie Cunningham in the wake of her comments supporting barring transgender girls and women from girls' and women's sports.

stories.title: Do-it-all Hill won't join Saints for 10th season
stories.summary: Taysom Hill, the only player in the Super Bowl era to have more than 1,000 yards rushing, receiving and passing, won't be returning to the Saints for a 10th season.

stories.title: Iamaleava: Chesney hiring made UCLA easy pick
stories.summary: UCLA's Nico Iamaleava said he and new coach Bob Chesney immediately clicked, making the quarterback's decision to stay with the Bruins an easy one.
